results.answer: An instructor must submit the leave request at least 14 days in advance through the HR portal. Emergency sick leave is exempt: the instructor must inform the department head before 7:30 on the day, and the department head arranges cover. [1]
The standard teaching load is 16 teaching hours per week. [1] The maximum is 24 teaching hours per week; teaching above 24 hours is not allowed, even with the instructor’s consent. [1]
Salary for the previous calendar month is paid on the 10th of each month. If the 10th falls on a weekend or public holiday, it is paid on the last business day before the 10th. [1]

The performance rating categories and target shares are: A — Outstanding, 10 percent; B+ — Exceeds expectations, 25 percent; B — Meets expectations, 50 percent; C — Below expectations, 15 percent. [1]
Two consecutive C ratings lead to a 60-day performance improvement plan (PIP). If the PIP goals are not met, employment may be ended with 30 days of notice. [1]
CNY 4,500 falls in the 1,001 to 10,000 band, so the Campus Director approves the claim. [1]
An expense claim must be submitted within 30 calendar days after the expense date. Claims submitted after 30 days need Finance Manager approval; claims older than 90 days are rejected. [1]
The hotel limit per night, including taxes, is CNY 600 in Shenzhen (Tier 1) [1], and CNY 450 in Xi'an (Tier 2) [1].
The meal allowance is a fixed CNY 100 per day for each full travel day, in all cities. No meal receipts are needed; the hotel invoice and transport tickets must support the travel days. [1]

Every business trip needs Department Head approval before booking; inter-campus teaching exchange trips for instructors also need Academic Office approval. Book through the company travel platform. Flights must be economy class and booked at least 7 days in advance; later bookings need Campus Director approval. [1]

The limit is CNY 300 per person per meal. The Campus Director must approve the entertainment in advance, in writing; the claim must list the guests and business purpose, and alcohol is not reimbursable. [1]
An instructor may spend up to CNY 500 per class group per month on teaching supplies without pre-approval. Spending above that requires pre-approval from the Department Head. [1]
Guangzhou: CNY 30 per working day. Wuhan: CNY 25 per working day.[1]
The annual health check is worth up to CNY 800 per year at a partner clinic. [1]

Instructors’ pay structure is 70 percent of target monthly pay as fixed base and 30 percent as performance pay. Performance pay is paid quarterly according to the rating: A pays 120 percent of target performance pay, B+ pays 110 percent, B pays 100 percent, and C pays 70 percent. [1]
An instructor at level I2 or above who relocates more than 500 km to join a Tier 1 campus receives a housing allowance of CNY 1,500 per month for the first 12 months. [1]
An item above CNY 20,000 is a capital item. It requires approval from the Campus Director and the Finance Controller. Capital items above CNY 100,000 also require approval from the CFO. [1]
Company invoices must show Tax ID: 91510000FAKE00001X (fictional, for demonstration). [1]

The Java course uses Temurin 21 (LTS); the course material and autograder use Java 21. Do not install JDK 8 or 17. [1] Set up `JAVA_HOME` to the JDK installation folder and add `%JAVA_HOME%\bin` (Windows) or `$JAVA_HOME/bin` (macOS and Linux) to `PATH`; then open a new terminal and check that `java -version` prints version 21. [1] Also install Maven 3.9.9 and add its `bin` folder to `PATH`, configure the StarIT Maven mirror in `~/.m2/settings.xml`, and install IntelliJ IDEA Community Edition with the project SDK set to Temurin 21 and Maven settings pointed to your Maven folder and `settings.xml`. [1] Install MySQL 8.4, set a root password, and create `starit_course` with `CREATE DATABASE starit_course CHARACTER SET utf8mb4;`. [2]

Add the StarIT campus mirror to `~/.m2/settings.xml` (create the file if needed); it is much faster than Maven Central on campus networks. [1][2]

```xml
<mirror>
  <id>starit</id>
  <mirrorOf>central</mirrorOf>
  <url>https://maven.starit.example/repository/public/</url>
</mirror>
``` [1]

20 hours falls within the allowed maximum of 24 teaching hours per week. Overload is the 4 hours above the standard 16 hours; at CNY 120 per hour, the overload pay is 4 × CNY 120 = CNY 480. [1][2]

Beijing is Tier 1, so the hotel limit is CNY 600 per night, including taxes. For 3 nights, the maximum hotel reimbursement is 3 × CNY 600 = CNY 1,800. A newly hired instructor can teach alone only after completing all three requirements: the 40-hour teaching certification (STC-1), observing 6 classes taught by experienced instructors, and teaching two supervised classes, each followed by written feedback from the mentor.
